headlines: New JUNO paper on arXiv: Refractive Neutrino Mass: Effects of Fluctuations of the Dark Matter Field (2611.26549v1, 2026-11-19). Check it against the locked Δm²21 bet.
New JUNO paper on arXiv: Future avenues for precision oscillation measurements with compact movable reactors (2611.26418v1, 2026-11-19). Check it against the locked Δm²21 bet.
New JUNO paper on arXiv: Geoneutrinos (and reactor neutrinos) do not visibly decay (2611.23978v1, 2026-11-18). Check it against the locked Δm²21 bet.
New JUNO paper on arXiv: Producing $μ$Bq/m3-level low-226Ra ultrapure water for the Jiangmen Underground Neutrino Observatory (2611.23711v1, 2026-11-18). Check it against the locked Δm²21 bet.

New JUNO paper on arXiv: Phenomenology of neutrino mass ordering synergies in reactor, accelerator, and atmospheric neutrino experiments, and the role of the detector response (2611.21252v2, 2026-11-16). Check it against the locked Δm²21 bet.
New JUNO paper on arXiv: An interrelation of three neutrino mixing angles (2611.09478v2, 2026-11-06). Check it against the locked Δm²21 bet.
